Staging mail DNS — chloepratas.com

Add these in Cloudflare. Do not replace the root domain's existing MX records
or the staging frontend's CNAME. All names below are relative to chloepratas.com.

Type: A
Name: mail.staging
Value: 104.105.15.153
Proxy: DNS only (grey cloud)

Type: MX
Name: notify.staging
Mail server: mail.staging.chloepratas.com
Priority: 10

Type: TXT
Name: notify.staging
Value: v=spf1 ip4:104.105.15.153 -all

Type: TXT
Name: mail.staging
Value: v=spf1 ip4:104.105.15.153 -all

Type: TXT
Name: _dmarc.notify.staging
Value: v=DMARC1; p=none; rua=mailto:dmarc@notify.staging.chloepratas.com

Type: TXT
Name: mail._domainkey.notify.staging
Value: v=DKIM1; h=sha256; k=rsa; 

In Linode, set reverse DNS (PTR) for 104.105.15.153 to:
mail.staging.chloepratas.com
The A record must be saved before Linode will accept this PTR.

Sender / SMTP account: accounts@notify.staging.chloepratas.com
Postmaster, DMARC reports, and bounces are delivered to the same local mailbox.
This file contains only public DNS information; no private signing keys.
